subject: Request: brief trial access extension — PO delayed
messages:
From: Meghan Kelly <meghan.kelly@orionmed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orionmed.com
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: brief trial access extension — PO delayed

Hi Jordan,

Quick note from procurement — we’ve hit an internal routing delay on the PO for the Redwood trial. The team has been running integration tests all week and we’re very close to an internal sign-off, but the PO approval is likely to slip past the trial cutoff (current expiration: 2026-04-12).

Would Redwood be able to do one of the following while procurement finishes the PO:
- grant a 2-week trial extension (preferred), or
- provision a short-term set of evaluation credits so we can continue testing without interruption?

We’ve attached the updated security questionnaire you requested in case that helps speed internal approval. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if useful.

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility here.

Meghan Kelly
Procurement Manager | OrionMed
meghan.kelly@orionmed.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: OrionMed_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Meghan Kelly <meghan.kelly@orionmed.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: brief trial access extension — PO delayed

Meghan — thanks for the heads up and for sending the questionnaire. Great to hear the tests are progressing.

Laura / Vivek — FYI, OrionMed (ORION-241) is asking for a short extension because their PO routing is delayed. Trial currently ends 4/12. Can we: 
1) approve a 14-day trial extension to 4/26 as a one-time goodwill? OR
2) provision provisional evaluation credits (suggestion: $5k worth) while PO completes.

Notes: the account is mid-PoC with a potential committed deal if procurement clears. I’ve pasted the procurement note below. If finance/legal require a stub form or an acknowledgment before extending, tell me and I’ll get it signed.

Meghan — I’ll confirm within a business day once leadership gives the green light. If we can extend, is there any configuration or support you need from our side to keep the PoC moving?

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (650) 555-0123

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 13:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: brief trial access extension — PO delayed

Jordan — thanks for flagging. Approve a one-time 14-calendar-day extension for OrionMed (ORION-241) to keep momentum. Conditions:
- Extension applies only to the existing trial account and PoC workspace; no production commit implied.
- If procurement provides a PO within the extension window, we’ll convert credits to committed billing per the signed order.
- Limit any provisional credits provisioned to evaluation consumption only; they should not be transferable.

Vivek — please provision the extension in the console and add a note on the account that it’s a discretionary extension tied to ORION-241. Also attach the trial-policy-credits.pdf to the account record.

Jordan — once done, confirm to Meghan with exact expiry date and any usage guardrails. Also paste HubSpot company link and deal id into the thread so I can close the approval in SF/finance.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 08 Apr 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: brief trial access extension — PO delayed

Meghan — good news, we can do that. Per internal approval I’ve extended OrionMed’s trial by 14 calendar days. New expiry: 2026-04-26 23:59 PDT.

What we changed:
- 14-day discretionary extension applied to the PoC workspace (no production entitlements).
- We added a usage note restricting provisional credits to evaluation traffic; any overage outside the PoC will be billed per standard terms.
- Attached the trial policy stub for your records and I added a comment on the HubSpot deal.

Next steps from your side: send the PO when it’s available and we’ll initiate the contracting workflow to convert the PoC to a committed seat order. If you want additional support during the extension window (integration help, dedicated debug session), reply with a preferred time and I’ll coordinate CS.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ORION-241
Deal ID: ORION-241

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

— Jordan
